vt. 刺, 扎, 刺痛, 射伤, 使面红耳赤, 使变粉红色
vi. 变粉红色

examples.en: She was wearing pink panties under the skirt.
examples.zh: 裙子下她穿著一条粉红色的内裤。

examples.en: Honeycake is a white kitten with purple eyes and a pink nose.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜蛋糕是一只白色的小猫，有著紫色的眼睛和粉红色的鼻子。

examples.en: Who is the woman dressed in pink?
examples.zh: 那个穿粉红色衣服的女人是谁？

wnsyn.desc: sound like a car engine that is firing too early
of a light shade of red
any of various flowers of plants of the genus Dianthus cultivated for their fragrant flowers

pint.definition: n. a British imperial capacity measure (liquid or dry) equal to 4 gills or 568.26 cubic centimeters\nn. a United States dry unit equal to 0.5 quart or 33.6 cubic inches\nn. a United States liquid unit equal to 16 fluid ounces; two pints equal one quart
pint.translation: n. 品脱(干量或液量的单位)\n[医] 量磅, 品脱

examples.en: I want a pint of beer.
examples.zh: 我想一品脱啤酒。

examples.en: Beer is sold by the pint.
examples.zh: 啤酒论品脱卖。

examples.en: Milk is sold by the pint.
examples.zh: 牛奶论品脱卖。

wnsyn.desc: a United States dry unit equal to 0.5 quart or 33.6 cubic inches

pious.definition: a. having or showing or expressing reverence for a deity
pious.translation: a. 虔诚的, 敬神的, 尽责的, 可嘉的, 不可能实现的

examples.en: Once upon a time there was a poor, pious girl.
I wish these pious people had reached more sensible conclusions.
Beware of Rome if you want to remain pious.

pistol.definition: n. a firearm that is held and fired with one hand
pistol.translation: n. 手枪, 信号枪\nvt. 以手枪杀死(或伤害)

examples.en: Never trust a woman with a pistol in hand.
examples.zh: 千万别相信一个手里拿手枪的女人。

examples.en: Tom got a pistol.
examples.zh: 汤姆得到了一把枪。

examples.en: Give me your pistol.
examples.zh: 把枪给我。

wnsyn.desc: a firearm that is held and fired with one hand

piston.definition: n. United States neoclassical composer (1894-1976)\nn. mechanical device that has a plunging or thrusting motion
piston.translation: n. 活塞, 活塞阀键\n[医] 活塞(如注射器的)

examples.en: The piston does not come into contact with the cylinder cover.
examples.zh: 这个活塞不接触汽缸盖。

wnsyn.desc: United States neoclassical composer (1894-1976)
mechanical device that has a plunging or thrusting motion

playground.definition: n. yard consisting of an outdoor area for children's play
playground.translation: n. 运动场, 操场, 度假胜地, 活动场所

examples.en: A group of young men are playing handball in the playground.
examples.zh: 一群年轻人在操场上打手球。

examples.en: A group of young people are playing handball on the playground.
examples.zh: 一群年轻人在操场上打手球。

plump.definition: n. the sound of a sudden heavy fall\nv. give support (to) or make a choice (of) one out of a group or number\nr. straight down especially heavily or abruptly
plump.translation:
a. 圆胖的, 丰满的, 直接下落的, 直率的
vt. 突然放下, 支持, 使丰满, 使鼓起
vi. 扑通落下, 投票赞成, 变丰满, 鼓起
adv. 沉重地, 突然地, 直截了当地

examples.en: When my grandmother was young, her body was very slim. Now in her old age she's grown plump.
examples.zh: 我奶奶年轻的时候身材很苗条，现在年纪大了就发福了。

wnsyn.desc: give support (to) or make a choice (of) one out of a group or number

plutocrat.definition: n. someone who exercises power by virtue of wealth

examples.en: The plutocrat is a person whose power comes from their wealth.
The world's plutocrats are globalized; the world proletariat must be internationalized.
Plutocrats love to buy things that oppose them.

pneumatic.definition: a. of or relating to or using air (or a similar gas)
pneumatic.translation: a. 充气的, 空气的, 有气胎的, 气动的, 灵魂的\nn. 充气轮胎

poisonous.definition: s. having the qualities or effects of a poison\ns. not safe to eat\ns. marked by deep ill will; deliberately harmful
poisonous.translation: a. 有毒的, 恶毒的, 讨厌的\n[医] 有毒的

examples.en: Are there many poisonous snakes in Australia?
examples.zh: 澳大利亚有很多毒蛇吗？

examples.en: We study a species of poisonous frog that looks very similar to a stone.
examples.zh: 我们研究一种和石头长得很像的毒青蛙。

examples.en: I like tulips and cats, but tulips are poisonous to cats. How should I choose?
examples.zh: 我喜欢郁金香和猫，可是郁金香对猫咪有毒，我该如何取舍呢？

wnsyn.desc: marked by deep ill will
having the qualities or effects of a poison

polarity.definition: n. having an indicated pole (as the distinction between positive and negative electric charges)
polarity.translation: n. 极性, 截然相反\n[医] 极性, 极性现象

examples.en: He might be able to reverse the polarity.
It'll work if I reverse the polarity.
He tried to reverse the polarity.

wnsyn.desc: having an indicated pole (as the distinction between positive and negative electric charges)

polymer.definition: n. a naturally occurring or synthetic compound consisting of large molecules made up of a linked series of repeated simple monomers
polymer.translation: n. 聚合物, 聚合体\n[化] 多聚体; 高分子; 大分子; 聚合物

examples.en: Every protein is a polymer composed of units called amino acids.
I learned about lots of different types of polymers today.
The elasticity of this polymer isn't the best suited to our ends.

porridge.definition: n. soft food made by boiling oatmeal or other meal or legumes in water or milk until thick

examples.en: There is a saying: cabbage soup and porridge are our food.
examples.zh: 俗话说：高丽菜汤和粥是我们的食物。

examples.en: The only way I can eat porridge is with lots of sugar.
examples.zh: 唯有加很多糖才能让我喝得下粥。

positively.definition: r. extremely\nr. so as to be positive; in a positive manner
positively.translation: adv. 明确地, 肯定地, 无疑地, (非正式)确实地, 真正地

examples.en: People of average height appear positively pint-sized next to Tom.
The good team spirit in the work group is valued positively.
I'm eager to contribute positively to the team and the company.

possibly.definition: r. by chance\nr. to a degree possible of achievement or by possible means

examples.en: Could you possibly suggest a way to solve the problem?
examples.zh: 你能提出解决问题的方法吗？

examples.en: My father will possibly come on the next train.
examples.zh: 我父亲可能会乘下一列火车来。

examples.en: Possibly the factory will be closed down next week.
examples.zh: 下周工厂可能会关。

wnsyn.desc: by chance

poster.definition: n. a sign posted in a public place as an advertisement
poster.translation: n. 海报, 招贴, 驿马

examples.en: He paused to look at the poster.
examples.zh: 他停下脚步看起海报。

examples.en: Where are those posters now?
examples.zh: 那些海报现在都到哪里去了？

wnsyn.desc: a sign posted in a public place as an advertisement

postman.definition: n a man who delivers the mail
postman.translation: n. 邮递员\n[法] 邮递员, 理财法庭的高级律师

examples.en: The postman delivers letters every morning.
examples.zh: 邮递员每天早上都去送信。

examples.en: Has the postman been yet?
examples.zh: 邮差来过了吗?

examples.en: Has the postman been?
examples.zh: 邮差来过了吗?

postulate.definition: n. (logic) a proposition that is accepted as true in order to provide a basis for logical reasoning\nv. take as a given; assume as a postulate or axiom
postulate.translation: n. 假定, 基本条件\nvt. 要求, 假定

examples.en: We need to postulate a completely different paradigm to explain all these phenomena.

wnsyn.desc: (logic) a proposition that is accepted as true in order to provide a basis for logical reasoning
take as a given

practicable.definition: s usable for a specific purpose\ns capable of being done with means at hand and circumstances as they are
practicable.translation: a. 可实行的, 可做的, 可用的

examples.en: The new plan was accounted practicable.
Her bold plan seemed to be too difficult, but before long it proved to be practicable.

practise.definition: v engage in a rehearsal (of)\nv carry out or practice; as of jobs and professions\nv learn by repetition
practise.translation: v. 实践, 实行, 练习, 实习, 从事(职业)

examples.en: Tom spends most of his spare time practising the guitar.
examples.zh: 汤姆把他大部分的空闲时间花在练习吉他上。

examples.en: How long have you been practising Chinese medicine in the UK?
examples.zh: 您在英国从事中医行业多长时间了？

examples.en: What are your reasons for practising Chinese medicine in the UK?
examples.zh: 您在英国从事中医工作的原因是什么？

examples.en: Laura Ingalls grew up on the prairie.
examples.zh: 劳拉英戈尔斯是在草原上长大的。

precipitate.definition:
n. a precipitated solid substance in suspension or after settling or filtering
v. bring about abruptly
v. separate as a fine suspension of solid particles
v. fall from clouds
precipitate.translation:
n. 沉淀物, 凝结物, 结果
vt. 猛抛, 使陷入, 促成, 使沉淀
vi. 猛地落下
a. 突然的, 猛地落下的, 轻率的

examples.en: A sudden decline in stock prices could precipitate a financial crisis.
The clouds thickened and it started to precipitate.
The assassination of the Archduke precipitated the outbreak of World War I.

wnsyn.desc: fall from clouds

preclude.translation: vt. 预先排除, 预防, 阻止, 妨碍\n[法] 预防, 排除, 消除

examples.en: But I don't think that the one precludes the other.
His lack of technical knowledge precluded him from promotion.
You can be both kind and firm. One does not preclude the other.

wnsyn.desc: make impossible, especially beforehand

predestine.definition: v. decree or determine beforehand\nv. foreordain by divine will or decree\nv. foreordain or determine beforehand

examples.en: Do you think that everything that happens to us is predestined?
Today is the day of my predestined meeting.
Some royal names are predestined to misfortune: in France, there is the name “Henry”.

wnsyn.desc: foreordain or determine beforehand
foreordain by divine will or decree

preferable.translation: a. 更可取的, 更好的, 更合意的

examples.en: I think death is preferable to shame.
examples.zh: 我觉得士可杀不可辱。

wnsyn.desc: more desirable than another

presently.definition: r. at this time or period; now

examples.en: The president is presently in Miami.
examples.zh: 总统目前在迈阿密。

examples.en: It is presently very difficult to calm down and treat oneself with a book.
examples.zh: 现在很难静下心来好好看一本书。

wnsyn.desc: at this time or period

preservation.definition: n. the activity of protecting something from loss or danger\nn. the condition of being (well or ill) preserved\nn. a process that saves organic substances from decay
preservation.translation: n. 保存, 保藏, 保护\n[医] 保藏, 保存, 防腐

examples.en: He has dedicated his life to the preservation of nature.
What are your views on the importance of language preservation?
The forest is in a better state of preservation.

wnsyn.desc: the activity of protecting something from loss or danger

preset.translation: vt. 事先调整\nn. 预调装置\n[计] 边框形式

examples.en: We highly recommend using one of three preset modes to achieve optimal results.
You can always preset it.
The new software deskills the editing process by reducing it to a few preset buttons.

wnsyn.desc: set in advance

pretty.definition: s. pleasing by delicacy or grace; not imposing\ns. (used ironically) unexpectedly bad
pretty.translation: a. 漂亮的, 优美的, 机灵的, 狡猾的, 恰当的\nadv. 相当, 颇

examples.en: I'm pretty sure we have enough gas to get home.
examples.zh: 我很确定我们有足够好的汽油回家。

examples.en: Red is very pretty, but it still can't beat blue.
examples.zh: 红色很漂亮，但还比不过蓝色。

examples.en: My mother bought me a pretty dress this past Sunday.
examples.zh: 上周日妈妈给我买了件漂亮的衣服。

prevailing.translation: a. 盛行很广的, 优势的, 主要的, 普遍的\n[法] 占优势的, 盛行的, 通行的

examples.en: In 2004, online dating wasn't as prevailing as it is today.
Bad cold is prevailing throughout the country.
On the eve of the conference, the prevailing mood was one of scepticism.

wnsyn.desc: most frequent or common

primate.definition: n. any placental mammal of the order Primates; has good eyesight and flexible hands and feet
primate.translation: n. 大主教, 灵长目动物\n[医] 灵长类

examples.en: Madame Berthe's mouse lemur is the smallest primate in the world.
Humans are the most widespread species of primate.
The primates include not only the apes, but also man.

printer.definition: n. someone whose occupation is printing\nn. (computer science) an output device that prints the results of data processing\nn. a machine that prints
printer.translation: n. 印刷工, 打印机\n[计] 打印机

examples.en: Please replace the empty ink cartridge in the printer.
examples.zh: 请把打印机里面的空的墨粉鼓换掉。

examples.en: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
examples.zh: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。

examples.en: Tom bought a new multifunction printer.
examples.zh: 汤姆买了一台新的多功能打印机。

wnsyn.desc: a machine that prints
someone whose occupation is printing

projecting.definition:
v communicate vividly
v extend out or project in space
v transfer (ideas or principles) from one domain into another
v project on a screen
v cause to be heard
v draw a projection of
v make or work out a plan for; devise
v present for consideration, examination, criticism, etc.
v imagine; conceive of; see in one's mind
v put or send forth
v throw, send, or cast forward
v regard as objective
s extending out above or beyond a surface or boundary
projecting.translation: a. 突出的, 伸出的

examples.en: Ziri is unhappy and is projecting that on his students.
I rubbed my eyes to see the image projecting in front of me.
When you smile, you're projecting happiness.

projector.definition: n. an optical device for projecting a beam of light\nn. an optical instrument that projects an enlarged image onto a screen
projector.translation: n. 计划人, 发起人, 规划人, 放映机, 映画器, 幻灯机, 幻灯, 探照灯, 发射器\n[计] 投影仪

examples.en: What's wrong with this projector? It won't display anything.
examples.zh: 这个投影仪怎么了？什么都放不出来。

promptly.definition: r. with little or no delay\nr. in a punctual manner\nr. at once (usually modifies an undesirable occurrence)
promptly.translation: adv. 敏捷地, 迅速地

examples.en: Would you please replace the broken one promptly?
examples.zh: 请快点把碎了的那个换掉好吗？

wnsyn.desc: in a punctual manner
with little or no delay
at once (usually modifies an undesirable occurrence)

propagation.definition: n. the spreading of something (a belief or practice) into new regions\nn. the movement of a wave through a medium
propagation.translation: n. 增殖, 繁殖, 宣传\n[医] 传播, 繁殖, 持续培养

examples.en: He wrote a book about the propagation of Islam in Africa.
The propagation of the HIV virus is progressing at a dreadful rate.
Ziri wanted to prune off a few ivy cuttings for propagation purposes.

wnsyn.desc: the spreading of something (a belief or practice) into new regions

prophecy.definition: n. knowledge of the future (usually said to be obtained from a divine source)\nn. a prediction uttered under divine inspiration
prophecy.translation: n. 预言, 预言能力

examples.en: She has a gift for prophecy.
examples.zh: 她有预言的能力。

examples.en: Your prophecy has come true.
examples.zh: 你的预言成真了。

wnsyn.desc: knowledge of the future (usually said to be obtained from a divine source)
a prediction uttered under divine inspiration

propulsion.definition: n. a propelling force\nn. the act of propelling
propulsion.translation: n. 推进, 推进力\n[医] 前冲, 慌张步态

examples.en: Rotating machines are essential in subsonic aeronautical propulsion.
The nautilus is a mollusk that uses jet propulsion to roam the ocean deep.
To overcome drag, airplanes use a propulsion system to generate a force called thrust.

wnsyn.desc: the act of propelling

protective.definition: a. intended or adapted to afford protection of some kind\ns. showing care\ns. (usually followed by `of') solicitously caring or mindful
protective.translation: a. 给予保护的, 保护的\n[医] 保护的, 防护的, 保护剂, 保护物, 油绸

examples.en: Have you noticed how Yanni is protective of his backpack?
Yanni's kids were taken away by the child protective services.
Medical staff have been using garbage bags as protective gowns.

proud.definition: a. feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth; or being a reason for pride
proud.translation: a. 骄傲的, 自大的, 自豪的, 辉煌的, 壮丽的

examples.en: I am proud to be a part of this project.
examples.zh: 我以身为这个计划的一份子为荣。

examples.en: Give me a chance to make you proud of me.
examples.zh: 给我机会来让你为我感到自豪。

examples.en: She is proud that her son has become a doctor.
examples.zh: 她为自己的儿子成为医生而自豪。

provided.definition:
v give something useful or necessary to
v give what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance
v determine (what is to happen in certain contingencies), especially by including a proviso condition or stipulation
v mount or put up
v make a possibility or provide opportunity for; permit to be attainable or cause to remain
v supply means of subsistence; earn a living
v take measures in preparation for
provided.translation: conj. 倘若, 以...为条件

examples.en: They've provided the library with a lot of books.
examples.zh: 他们给图书馆提供了很多书。

examples.en: I'll lend you the book, provided you return it next week.
examples.zh: 如果你可以在下个星期还给我的话，这本书就借给你吧。

examples.en: They have provided the library with a large number of books.
examples.zh: 他们给图书馆提供了很多书。

provost.translation: n. 教务长, 监督员, 牧师\n[法] 监督者, 负责官员, 监狱看守

examples.en: Tom is the provost of Harvard University.
Tom emailed the provost with his complaint.
In some Scottish cities, the equivalent of a mayor is called a provost.

pudding.definition: n. any of various soft thick unsweetened baked dishes\nn. (British) the dessert course of a meal (`pud' is used informally)\nn. any of various soft sweet desserts thickened usually with flour and baked or boiled or steamed

examples.en: Did you just eat forty servings of pudding?
examples.zh: 你刚刚吃了四十份布丁吗？

examples.en: This is your pudding.
examples.zh: 这是你的布丁。

wnsyn.desc: (British) the dessert course of a meal (`pud' is used informally)

puff.definition:
n. a short light gust of air
n. a light inflated pastry or puff shell
n. exaggerated praise (as for promotional purposes)
n. a slow inhalation (as of tobacco smoke)
puff.translation: n. 一阵喷烟, 肿块, 喘息\nv. 喷出, 张开, 吹捧, (使)充气, 喘气, (使)骄傲, (使)膨胀

examples.en: I went and bought some cream puffs. Do you want any?
examples.zh: 我去买了泡芙，你要吃吗？

examples.en: I want a dozen cream puffs.
examples.zh: 我要一打奶油泡芙。

wnsyn.desc: to swell or cause to enlarge
suck in or take (air)
a slow inhalation (as of tobacco smoke)

pulley.definition: n. a simple machine consisting of a wheel with a groove in which a rope can run to change the direction or point of application of a force applied to the rope
pulley.translation: n. 滑车, 滑轮\n[医] 滑车

examples.en: We put the piano up here using a pulley.
Ziri asked Yazid if he could borrow his pulley.
The screw, the lever, the wedge, the pulley, etc. are called simple machines.

wnsyn.desc: a simple machine consisting of a wheel with a groove in which a rope can run to change the direction or point of applica

puppy.definition: n. a young dog\nn. an inexperienced young person
puppy.translation: n. 小狗, 小动物, 自负的年轻人

examples.en: He loves his puppy. His puppy is really adorable.
examples.zh: 他爱他的狗，那只小狗真的很可爱。

examples.en: There’s a heartwarming story about a rescued puppy.
examples.zh: 有一个温馨感人的故事，是关于一只获救的狗狗的。

examples.en: This is the cutest puppy I've ever seen.
examples.zh: 这是我见过最可爱的小狗。

wnsyn.desc: an inexperienced young person

purse.definition:
n. a sum of money spoken of as the contents of a money purse
n. a small bag for carrying money
n. a sum of money offered as a prize
v. contract one's lips into a rounded shape
purse.translation: n. 钱包, 小钱袋, 金钱, 募捐款, 囊状物\nv. 缩拢, 皱起

examples.en: I had my purse stolen in the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公车上给偷了钱包。

examples.en: It occurred to me that I had left my purse at home.
examples.zh: 我突然想起钱包好像放在家中，忘了带了。

examples.en: She gave the boy what few coins she had in her purse.
examples.zh: 她把她钱包里仅有的几枚硬币都给了那个男孩。

wnsyn.desc: gather or contract into wrinkles or folds

pyjamas.definition: n a pair of loose trousers tied by a drawstring around the waist; worn by men and women in some Asian countries\nn (usually plural) loose-fitting nightclothes worn for sleeping or lounging; have a jacket top and trousers
pyjamas.translation: n. 睡衣裤, 宽松裤

examples.en: One morning I shot an elephant in my pyjamas.
examples.zh: 一天早晨我穿着睡衣射了一头大象

examples.en: Do you wear pyjamas when you sleep?
examples.zh: 你睡觉时穿睡衣吗？

examples.en: These are unisex pyjamas.
examples.zh: 这几件睡衣是不分性别的。
